newsitem.title: USA: Grand Toys holder gives up stock options.
newsitem.headline: Grand Toys holder gives up stock options.

text.p: Grand Toys International Inc of Dorval, Quebec, said Tuesday that Amgo Investments Inc, a major shareholder, was surrendering options to buy 1.25 million Grand Toys common shares.
It said the options were granted in October 1993 and would have been exercisable through October 2003 at $3.50 per share.
It said Amgo's action further reduces dilutive effects of common stock equivalents.
After the surrender, Amgo will continue to hold directly or indirectly 3.285 million shares representing 41.6 percent of Grand Toys's outstanding common stock, it said.
